Today's borders; a country is coloured by the regime of the state that ruled it, where V-Dem or OWID gives one (OWID imputes some pre-independence years from the ruling or parent state). Divided states (Germany 1949-90, Vietnam to 1975, Yemen to 1990) have no single value and show as no data, as do Palestine and countries V-Dem does not cover (mostly small states).
